subject: Thanks for signing up — pick a time for your quick demo
messages:
From: signup@redwood-inference.com
To: Jamie Torres <jamie@nimanalytics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: leads@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 08 May 2029 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — your intro is scheduled (action: pick a time)

Hi Jamie,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood Inference! We're excited to show how our inference platform can reduce latency and cost for production apps.

What's next:
- Pick a 20–30 minute slot with our engineer or sales lead for a short walkthrough: https://calendly.com/redwood/vivek-30
- If you'd rather, reply with up to 3 times that work for you and we'll coordinate.

I've tentatively attached a calendar stub so you can save a placeholder while you pick a time. (redwood-demo.ics)

Attached: redwood-demo.ics

Thanks,
Redwood Signups (automated)
signup@redwood-inference.com

--
This is an automated confirmation. If you'd like a personalized intro, Vivek Kulkarni (cc) is your SDR and will follow up shortly.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie@nimanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 May 2029 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — your intro is scheduled (action: pick a time)

Hi Jamie — welcome, and congrats on getting the trial started. I'm Vivek, your SDR — nice to meet you.

Quick note to make scheduling painless: pick any 20–30min slot on my calendar here and it'll auto-confirm: https://calendly.com/redwood/vivek-30

If you're exploring for a specific use case (inference at scale, private deployment, or cost optimization), reply with a sentence and I'll route you to the right engineer.

If you'd prefer, I can propose two windows based on your timezone — what timezone are you in?

Attachments: nim-quick-intake.pdf (one-page intake so we can tailor the demo).

Next steps:
- You: pick a time or reply with availability / timezone
- Me: confirm the engineer and drop a calendar invite + short agenda

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
SDR, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
https://redwood.ai

--
(Notes: Monica will handle the technical pairing if they ask for a deep-dive.)

Use case: we ingest streaming logs into a search layer and want to add semantic search & summarization for user sessions — curious about latency/cost tradeoffs and whether you support hybrid private deployments.

I also attached a quick doc from our side (forwarded internally) — will bring our infra lead to the call.

See you then.
